# NON-MALIGNANT CELL
## DietSeurat
```{r}
# filter out malignant cells
sts.non.malignant <- subset(sts.simspec.sct, subset = simspec_cell_class %in% c("Malignant acinar","PDA_OLGC","PDAC"), invert = T) 

# filter out rare malignant samples
sts.non.malignant <- subset(sts.non.malignant, subset = Patient_ID %in% c("1959","2185"), invert = T) #35493 cells

# DietSeurat
dim(sts.non.malignant)
DefaultAssay(sts.non.malignant) <- "RNA"
sts.non.malignant <- DietSeurat(sts.non.malignant, assays = "RNA", data = TRUE, counts = TRUE)
colnames(sts.non.malignant[[]]) #check which columns to remove

sts.non.malignant[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.0.9"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1.1"]] <- NULL
sts.non.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1.2"]] <- NULL
```

## Normalised by SCTransform v2 as a whole -> PCA 
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
# SCTRANFORM
sts.non.malignant <- SCTransform(sts.non.malignant, vst.flavor = "v2", 
                                 method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = TRUE
                                 )

# DIMENTIONALITY REDUCTION
sts.non.malignant <- RunPCA(sts.non.malignant, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE, assay = "SCT")
ElbowPlot(sts.non.malignant)

DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, label = TRUE,
        reduction = "pca", group.by = "Patient_ID")# + NoLegend()

sts.non.malignant <- RunUMAP(sts.non.malignant, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

# CLUSTERING
sts.non.malignant <- FindNeighbors(sts.non.malignant, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

#sts.non.malignant <- FindClusters(sts.non.malignant, algorithm = 3,  resolution = c(0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8)) # 
#sts.non.malignant <- FindClusters(sts.non.malignant, algorithm = 3,  resolution = c(0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3)) # 
sts.non.malignant <- FindClusters(sts.non.malignant, algorithm = 3,  resolution = 0.7) # 


library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(sts.non.malignant) 

# Decided on the resolution
Idents(sts.non.malignant) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.7" # define FRCs as previously
DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, group.by = "simspec_cell_class", label = T, repel = T) +
  DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, group.by = "cell_class", label = T, repel = T) +
  DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, label = T)
```

## FindMarkers
```{r}
DefaultAssay(sts.non.malignant) <- "SCT"
Idents(sts.non.malignant) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.7"
sts.non.malignant.markers <- FindAllMarkers(sts.non.malignant, only.pos = T, assay = "SCT",
                                            min.pct = 0.15, logfc.threshold = 0.3)

sts.non.malignant.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    #filter(pct.1 > 0.25) %>%

```

## Cell assignment 
`Lv.1.Anno` was assigned to the resolution-0.7 clusters by number in the original analysis. Cluster numbers can change between environments, so `Lv.1.Anno` is read from the deposited object (`stage3_Lv.1.Anno`), matched by cell ID. The original mapping is still applied to the rerun clusters, as `Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster`, and compared with it.

```{r lv1-annotation, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, results='asis'}
metadata <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() 
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)
# Original mapping of resolution-0.7 clusters to Lv.1.Anno
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.1.Anno = case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("1","19","17","20","27","28") ~ "Myeloid", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("0","3","25") ~ "CAFs", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "14" ~ "Pericytes", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "24" ~ "FRCs", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "8" ~ "Endothelial", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "23" ~ "Mast", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "15" ~ "Plasma",#check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "21" ~ "Tuft", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("4","5") ~ "Ductal epithelial", #check
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "18" ~ "Ductal MUC5B+",#check
                                          #seurat_clusters == "25" ~ "Acinar-Ductal",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "9" ~ "Acinar",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("6","7","10") ~ "Endocrine",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("2","11","12","16","22","26") ~ "Lymphoid", 
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "29" ~ "Schwann",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "30" ~ "FDCs",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "13" ~ "B",
                                          SCT_snn_res.0.7 == "31" ~ "B:GC")) -> metadata
                                          
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(sts.non.malignant)))
sts.non.malignant$Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster <- metadata$Lv.1.Anno

# Lv.1.Anno from the deposited object
sts.non.malignant$Lv.1.Anno <- deposited_labels(sts.non.malignant, "stage3_Lv.1.Anno")
sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% group_by(Lv.1.Anno) %>% dplyr::count() %>% print(n=51)

print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(sts.non.malignant$SCT_snn_res.0.7, sts.non.malignant$Lv.1.Anno,
                                    "Non-malignant: rerun clusters (res 0.7) vs Lv.1.Anno", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(sts.non.malignant$Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster, sts.non.malignant$Lv.1.Anno,
                                  "Non-malignant: Lv.1.Anno by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))
DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, group.by = "Lv.1.Anno") + DimPlot(sts.non.malignant, group.by = "cell_class")
```

# TUFT CELL ANALYSIS
## Reclustered of Tuft
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
tuft <- subset(sts.non.malignant, subset = Lv.1.Anno == "Tuft")
table(tuft$Patient_ID)

# Combined samples with small Tuft < 5 cells
# Reassign cluster names 
metadata <- tuft@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata %>% mutate(Patient_c = case_when(Patient_ID  == "2156" ~ "2156",
                                          Patient_ID  == "2215" ~ "2215",
                                          Patient_ID  == "2221" ~ "2221",
                                          Patient_ID  == "2285" ~ "2285",
                                          Patient_ID  == "2925" ~ "2925",
                                          TRUE ~ "4Pats" )) -> metadata
metadata %>% group_by(Patient_ID) %>% count(Patient_c)
Patient_c <- metadata$Patient_c 
names(Patient_c) <- metadata$S_CB
tuft <- AddMetaData(object = tuft, metadata = Patient_c, col.name = "Patient_c")

# DietSeurat
colnames(tuft[[]]) #check which columns to remove
tuft[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
tuft[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
tuft[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
tuft[["SCT_snn_res.0.6"]] <- NULL
tuft[["SCT_snn_res.0.7"]] <- NULL
tuft[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL

# Due to small number of cells < 30 -> can't do integration
tuft <- SplitObject(tuft, split.by = "Patient_c") 

tuft <- lapply(tuft, FUN= SCTransform, vst.flavor="v2", assay = "RNA", method = "glmGamPoi",
              variable.features.n = 2000, # default, have seen range from 2000-5000
              )

features.split <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = tuft, nfeatures = 2000)

tuft.merged <- merge(x=tuft[[1]], y=tuft[2:length(tuft)])
VariableFeatures(tuft.merged) <- features.split

# Dimentionality reduction
tuft.merged <- RunPCA(tuft.merged, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE, assay = "SCT")
ElbowPlot(tuft.merged)

DimPlot(tuft.merged, label = TRUE,
        reduction = "pca", group.by = "Patient_c") + NoLegend()

tuft.merged <- RunUMAP(tuft.merged, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

# Clustering
tuft.merged <- FindNeighbors(tuft.merged, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)

# Determine cluster stability
tuft.merged <- FindClusters(tuft.merged, algorithm = 3,  resolution = seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1))

library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(tuft.merged) 

DimPlot(tuft.merged, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.9") + #DimPlot(tuft.merged, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.1") + 
  DimPlot(tuft.merged, group.by = "Patient_c")
```

## Tuft with CNA in 2221/ICGC_0105
`Lv.2.Anno` was assigned partly by cluster number in the original analysis: `Tuft.persistent` is tuft clusters 2 and 3 at resolution 0.9, and `Ductal_MUC5B+` is non-malignant clusters 5 and 18 at resolution 0.7. As for `Lv.1.Anno`, it is read from the deposited object (`stage3_Lv.2.Anno`), and the original mapping, applied to the rerun clusters and to `Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster`, is kept as `Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster` and compared with it.

```{r lv2-annotation, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
# Original mapping
# Patient 2221 contain multiple cell types that could be malignant, we confirmed by inferCNV that all tuft have CNAs
tuft.malignant <- subset(tuft.merged, subset = SCT_snn_res.0.9 %in% c("2","3"))
tuft.malignant.BC <- tuft.malignant$Cell_Ids %>% as.character() # total 106 cells

# add labelling 
AD.cells <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster == "Acinar" & cell_class == "Ductal_epithelial") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
Muc5b <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(SCT_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("5","18")) %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()

# Update STS_non_malignant object
metadata <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata$Lv.1.Anno <- metadata$Lv.1.Anno_by_cluster   # the original mapping builds on the original Lv.1.Anno mapping
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.2.Anno = case_when(Cell_Ids %in% AD.cells ~ "Acinar-Ductal", #344
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Acinar" ~ "Acinar", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "B" ~ "B",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "B:GC" ~ "B:GC",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "CAFs" ~ "CAFs", 
                                          Cell_Ids %in% Muc5b ~ "Ductal_MUC5B+", #2421
                                          Lv.1.Anno %in% c("Ductal epithelial","Ductal MUC5B+") ~ "Ductal epithelial", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Endocrine" ~ "Endocrine", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Endothelial" ~ "Endothelial",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "FDCs" ~ "FDCs", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "FRCs" ~ "FRCs",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Lymphoid" ~ "Lymphoid",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Mast" ~ "Mast", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Myeloid" ~ "Myeloid", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Pericytes" ~ "Pericytes", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Plasma" ~ "Plasma", 
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Schwann" ~ "Schwann",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% tuft.malignant.BC ~ "Tuft.persistent",
                                          Lv.1.Anno == "Tuft" ~ "Tuft")) -> metadata
stopifnot(identical(metadata$S_CB, colnames(sts.non.malignant)))
sts.non.malignant$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster <- metadata$Lv.2.Anno

# Lv.2.Anno from the deposited object
sts.non.malignant$Lv.2.Anno <- deposited_labels(sts.non.malignant, "stage3_Lv.2.Anno")
sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% group_by(Lv.1.Anno) %>% count(Lv.2.Anno) %>% print(n=51)

tuft.persistent <- deposited_labels(tuft.merged, "stage3_Lv.2.Anno") == "Tuft.persistent"
print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(tuft.merged$SCT_snn_res.0.9, ifelse(tuft.persistent, "Tuft.persistent", "Tuft"),
                                    "Tuft (4 ADM patients): rerun clusters (res 0.9) vs Tuft.persistent", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(sts.non.malignant$Lv.2.Anno_by_cluster, sts.non.malignant$Lv.2.Anno,
                                  "Non-malignant: Lv.2.Anno by cluster vs deposited", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))
# Saved once, with both Lv.1.Anno and Lv.2.Anno
saveRDS(sts.non.malignant, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "sts.nonmalignant.RDS"))
```

## Pseudobulk - based on annotated clusters on sts.non.malignant object
```{r}
# Note: can't include persistent tuft in this pseudobulk as it comes from only 1 patient
DefaultAssay(ADM) <- "RNA"
adm <- ADM

# Converting cluster name into numerical
Idents(adm) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno <- as.factor(adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno)
print(levels(adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
levels(adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) <- 1:length(levels(adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno))
#[1] "Acinar"            "Acinar-Ductal"     "Ductal epithelial" "Ductal_MUC5B+"     "Tuft" 
print(1:length(levels(adm$Lv.2.Anno)))
#[1] 1 2 3 4 5

ClusterSub <- as.factor(adm@meta.data$Lv.2.Anno) 
PatClust <- paste(adm$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#

counts <- adm@assays$RNA@counts #dgCMatrix
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
counts <- t(rowsum(t(counts), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

ncls <- length(table(ClusterSub))
N <- 1:ncls #focus on all clusters
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% N] 
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, min.count=3, min.total.count=10) #min=10, min.total.count=20
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 16, col = ADM.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")
 
#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~ Cls + Pat)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(
    Cls1 = -(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls2 = Cls2-(Cls3+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls3 = Cls3-(Cls2+Cls4+Cls5)/4,
    Cls4 = Cls4-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls5)/4,
    Cls5 = Cls5-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4)/4,
    levels=design)

ctest <- list()
for (i in 1:ncls) ctest[[i]] <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast = contr[,i])

#log-CPM
prior.count <- 1
ClstSub.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(ClstSub, log=T, prior.count=prior.count) #calculating cpm

# Remove batch effect on log-CPM
logCPM_no_batch <- removeBatchEffect(ClstSub.cpm, batch=Pat, group = Cls) # for visualisation purposes only
plotMDS(logCPM_no_batch, pch = 16, col = ADM.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="Pseudo-bulk samples")

library(tibble)
names(ctest) <- colnames(contr)   # Cls1 ... Cls5
res_list <- lapply(names(ctest), function(cn) {
  topTags(ctest[[cn]], n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(cluster = cn)
})
names(res_list) <- names(ctest)
adm.cellnames.pseudobulk <- bind_rows(res_list)
adm.cellnames.pseudobulk %>% mutate(cell_names = case_when(
                                         cluster == "Cls1" ~ "Acinar",
                                         cluster == "Cls2" ~ "Acinar-Ductal",
                                         cluster == "Cls3" ~ "Ductal epithelial",
                                         cluster == "Cls4" ~ "Ductal_MUC5B+",
                                         cluster == "Cls5" ~ "Tuft",
                                         )) ->adm.cellnames.pseudobulk

### Supplementary Table 3 
# Originally saved as Final_adm.cellnames.pseudobulk.removed.tuft.malig_revisedFDR.csv
write.csv(adm.cellnames.pseudobulk, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "SupplementaryTable3_adm_pseudobulk.csv"), row.names = F)
```

## Subsetting ADM samples
```{r}
sts.simspec.sct <- readRDS(cfg$integrated_object)
ADM.Pat <- subset(sts.simspec.sct, subset = Patient_ID %in% c("2285","2215","2221","2156") &
                                            simspec_cell_class %in% c("Acinar","PDAC","Ductal_epithelial","Tuft"))

# Transferring label from non-malignant analysis
acinar <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Acinar") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
ad <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Acinar-Ductal") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
ductal <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Ductal epithelial") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
muc5b <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Ductal_MUC5B+") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
tuft <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Tuft") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()
tuft.malig <- sts.non.malignant@meta.data %>% dplyr::filter(Lv.2.Anno == "Tuft.persistent") %>% pull(Cell_Ids) %>% as.character()

metadata <- ADM.Pat@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() #Creating a data frame called metadata
metadata$S_CB <- rownames(metadata)#Assigning S_CB as a new column (CB=cell barcode)
metadata %>% mutate(Lv.2.Anno = case_when(Cell_Ids %in% ad ~ "Acinar-Ductal", #349
                                          Cell_Ids %in% acinar ~ "Acinar", 
                                          Cell_Ids %in% muc5b  ~ "Ductal_MUC5B+",
                                          Cell_Ids %in% ductal  ~ "Ductal epithelial", 
                                          Cell_Ids %in% tuft  ~ "Tuft", 
                                          Cell_Ids %in% tuft.malig ~ "Tuft.malignant", # to highlight that uniquely presented in sample #2221
                                          TRUE ~ "PDAC")) -> metadata
metadata %>% group_by(Lv.2.Anno) %>% count()
Lv.2.Anno <- metadata$Lv.2.Anno
names(Lv.2.Anno) <- metadata$S_CB
ADM.Pat <- AddMetaData(object = ADM.Pat, metadata = Lv.2.Anno, col.name = "Lv.2.Anno")

DefaultAssay(ADM.Pat) <- "RNA"
Idents(ADM.Pat) <- "Lv.2.Anno"
ADM.Pat

# Create another column to group all Tuft together for plotting
ADM.Pat$broad_cell_class <- ADM.Pat$Lv.2.Anno
ADM.Pat$broad_cell_class[ADM.Pat$broad_cell_class == "Tuft.malignant"] <- "Tuft" 
ADM.Pat$broad_cell_class <- factor(ADM.Pat$broad_cell_class, levels = c("Acinar","Acinar-Ductal","Ductal epithelial","Ductal_MUC5B+","PDAC","Tuft"))
```

### Plotting
```{r ext-data-fig-4a, fig.width=15, fig.height=5, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
our <- list()
our$acinar <- c("CPB1","CTRC","CELA3A","PNLIP","PRSS1","CUZD1","CTRB2","CPA2","SPINK1")
our$REG <- c("REG1B","REG3A","REG3G","REG1A")
our$acinar.ductal <- c("BNIP5","PRKD1","MECOM","OLFM4","FGD6","ABLIM2","IL32","CXCL2")
our$ductal <- c("CFTR","SLC4A4","PKHD1","ONECUT2","BICC1","GLIS3","SCTR")
our$ductal.like2 <- c("MUC6","MUC5B","MUC3A","TFF2","CALN1","SERPINA1","IL33")
our$PDAC <- c("CDKN2A","SMAD4","PIK3CA","KRT7","KRT20","KRT19","KRT5","MUC1","CDH1","SDC1","FXYD3","KRT17","KRT8","EPCAM","TFF1","PPARG","CAPN8","TMC5","ACTN4","LMO7")
our$Tuft <- c("TRPM5","POU2F3","AVIL","BMX","SH2D6","SH2D7")

DefaultAssay(ADM.Pat)
DotPlot(ADM.Pat, features = our, group.by = "broad_cell_class") + RotatedAxis() + scale_color_gradient2(low="darkblue", mid="white", high="darkred") #+labs(title="Expression of marker genes derived from our previous analysis")
```
